rows.subsection: 1.1 Definitions. In this contract, the following definitions apply: / Def: Activities of Daily Living
rows.clause_text: "Activities of Daily Living" means both basic activities of daily living and instrumental activities of daily living. Basic activities of daily living are ambulating, transfers, feeding, personal hygiene, dressing, and toileting. Instrumental activities of daily living are more complex activities related to the ability to live independently in the community.

rows.subsection: 1.1 Definitions. In this contract, the following definitions apply: / Def: Competitive Integrated Employment
rows.clause_text: "Competitive Integrated Employment" means work performed by Persons in the community alongside people of all abilities. The employer is not a contracted Department of Health and Human Services, Division of Services for People with Disabilities ("DSPD") provider. Persons are compensated at or above minimum wage or comparable to people without disabilities who work in the same place and perform the same or similar work; and with equal access to opportunities for advancement and benefits.

rows.subsection: 20.1 General Description. PPS provides a community integrated residential setting in a professional parent family home, providing support and services to Persons below the age of 22. The PPS setting is the Person's primary residence. PPS is provided for up to 24-hours on holidays and weekends and for up to 18-hours per day when the Person is in school, at work, or receiving other daytime support. Subcontracting is allowed under this service code.
